blocks.text: SINGAPORE – An Asia-Pacific initiative was launched in Singapore on Nov 3 to identify emerging infectious disease threats through predictive modeling for earlier intervention. The Asia Pacific One Health Initiative (APOHI), based in Singapore, will bring together regional partners, experts and institutions across human, wildlife and environmental health to build a more integrated approach to detecting early signs of such threats. This is especially important in the Asia-Pacific, where dense populations and rich biodiversity heighten the risk of emerging zoonotic disease threats or animal-to-human spillovers.
